claims.value: 46 total-proteome RAW files (35 individual + 11 species mix_pro)
claims.evidence: PRIDE files/all lists 57 RAW; XLSX maps 46 A_Total_proteome_* and 11 B_Phosphoproteome_*. This SDRF covers only A_Total_proteome.
PRIDE organisms and Methods skin-fibroblast panel. Dog mapped to Canis lupus familiaris (NCBITaxon:9615).
Mixed Homo sapiens + non-human vertebrates; organism templates human/vertebrates are mutually exclusive. Follows mixed-species precedent (e.g. PXD002815) omitting organism-layer template.

Methods: Human SF purchased ATCC CRL-4001 (= BJ-5ta / BJ1-hTERT, Cellosaurus CVCL_6573, male foreskin donor, hTERT-immortalized). Non-human rows remain primary explant cultures (material type cell; cell-line fields not applicable).
Study frames all samples as skin fibroblasts; human ATCC line is foreskin-derived but organism part kept as skin of body for panel consistency.
No disease model; BJ-5ta is non-disease-derived immortalized fibroblast.

claims.value: SN= individual fibroblast sources; biological replicate=pooled
claims.evidence: Methods: peptide-level samples and pooled mixtures per species; XLSX labels mix_pro as A_Total_proteome_<Species>_N.

claims.value: DIA; Orbitrap Fusion Lumos; label free; Carbamidomethyl/Oxidation/Acetyl; HCD 28%; MS1 350-1650
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocols and Sci Adv Methods Spectronaut DirectDIA / DIA-MS section.
Cross-species proteotype coevolution design with matched fibroblast type.

limitations: Paper Methods text says five human proteome replicates, but six individual human RAW files (HsSF_A–F) are deposited; SDRF follows deposited files (XLSX A_Total_proteome_Human_1–6).
Age and strain remain not available (not reported per culture). Developmental stage left not available despite Cellosaurus donor age <1 month for BJ-5ta.
cell-lines organism-layer templates not declared because the file mixes primary non-human fibroblasts with one human line; cell-line columns are still populated for human rows.
Precursor/fragment tolerances not stated for Spectronaut defaults; left not available.
Published PRIDE/paper search description erroneously lists Cavia_porcellus FASTA for opossum; SDRF organism remains Monodelphis domestica per biology/methods elsewhere.
